def get_ludic(n):
    ludic = list(range(1, n + 1))
    i = 1
    while i < len(ludic):
        step = ludic[i]
        remove = set(range(i + step, len(ludic), step))
        ludic = [x for j, x in enumerate(ludic) if j not in remove]
        i += 1
    return ludic

assert get_ludic(10) == [1, 2, 3, 5, 7]
